boundary: Every failed witness is retained at zero credit; inherited repository and external-overlay layers remain separate.

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first repository probe targeted the Codex configuration directory and Git correctly reported that it was not a repository.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Resolve and use the literal verified D-drive source worktree before any Git operation.
phase_rows.title: Default Codex directory was not a Git worktree

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first authorization-state presentation exceeded the useful output window and could not prove an EOF read.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Recover with bounded numbered UTF-8 chunks through the exact final line and validate the schema separately.
phase_rows.title: Authorization-state whole-file display was truncated

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first grouped line-window recovery clipped portions of the committed activation candidate and earned no complete-read credit.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Read one non-overlapping UTF-8 line window per call through line 1081 and verify the manifest digest independently.
phase_rows.title: Combined activation-baton windows still exceeded presentation budget

phase_rows.failure_signature: A search across four plausible receipt banks found no Elaren v673-v4 canonical digest and earned zero receipt credit.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Inspect bounded top-level receipt directory names, resolve the exact final-qualified directory, and hash its two exact files.
phase_rows.title: Narrow receipt-bank search returned no attributable source receipt

phase_rows.failure_signature: A densely quoted read-only Python command was parsed as an invalid PowerShell ScriptBlock before Python ran.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Place the exact dependency-only Python source in a literal PowerShell variable and invoke it without replaying the canonical aggregate.
phase_rows.title: Independent manifest replay one-liner was rejected by PowerShell parsing

phase_rows.failure_signature: The new worktree remained unmaterialized and status showed 10375 staged deletions after the first sparse-set operation.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Treat the state as incomplete, keep the lane isolated, and populate its index from exact HEAD with sparse-aware read-tree.
phase_rows.title: Initial no-checkout sparse set exposed staged deletions

phase_rows.failure_signature: Git's sparse reapply returned without error but left the same 10375 staged deletions and zero materialized files.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Do not repeat reapply; use read-tree -mu HEAD once and verify clean exact source state.
phase_rows.title: Sparse-checkout reapply did not recover the empty checkout

phase_rows.failure_signature: A literal checkout-path probe expected older Neris builder files that existed in the Git tree but were intentionally absent from the sparse source checkout.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Use git tree inspection for historical paths and a materialized current-owner template for bounded mechanical adaptation.
phase_rows.title: Sparse source did not materialize historical Neris builders

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first x1 build stopped before writing evidence because nine proposed titles met or exceeded the fixed 0.72 token-Jaccard collision threshold against inherited source titles.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Retain the zero-credit rejection, rewrite those titles at the concept level without changing their protected outcomes, and rerun the planning builder once against the same immutable corpus.
phase_rows.title: Initial semantic-neighbor gate rejected nine near-template titles

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first read-only rg expression for x2 test assertions contained an unclosed group and returned no attributable inspection result.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Compile or simplify compound inspection patterns before using them across a large file.
phase_rows.title: Test-inspection regular expression was syntactically incomplete

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first multi-tool inspection passed a shell-style wildcard as a literal Windows path and rg rejected that path.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Never pass shell-style file globs as literal Windows path arguments to rg.
phase_rows.title: Windows wildcard was passed as a literal rg path

phase_rows.failure_signature: The pinned D-isolated download and install command reached package installation but the 30-second execution surface returned before a final success or import-smoke payload.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: After an ambiguous package timeout, inspect persisted state before any retry and repair only a proven missing dependency.
phase_rows.title: D-isolated package command returned before its final receipt

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first fifteen-file mypy gate reported thirty import-not-found errors across ten generated runners because their runtime sibling imports resolve from the scripts directory rather than the repository root; Pyright and the changed Method Flow test did not run in that invocation.

phase_rows.failure_signature: The first read-only evidence-head probe let PowerShell interpret the unquoted @{upstream} shorthand, and git rejected the resulting nonrevision token.

phase_rows.failure_signature: A compound PowerShell stale-label probe escaped an embedded quote into an unterminated rg alternation, so rg rejected the read-only expression before scanning.
phase_rows.recurrence_guard: Avoid mixing PowerShell string delimiters with a large regular-expression alternation when fixed-string label checks are sufficient.
phase_rows.title: Combined stale-label grep lost its closing regex group
